verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a hosted remote MCP endpoint, TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs, and a REST API. It never mentions an official CLI for authenticating, building, pushing or installing servers into agents. SDKs and an API are developer building blocks, not the CLI workflow the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
